context.author: claudeai
context.text:
我们要给 Max 套餐改名：

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max 仍是每月 $100，Ultra 仍是 $200。如果你是订阅用户，不需要做任何操作。

我们还将取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时限制，从今天起对大多数现有订阅用户生效。较新的账户在完成验证前会保留一个临时限制，这有助于我们防止欺诈和滥用。限制解除后你会收到邮件。

每周限制保持不变。在此查看我们的套餐：http://claude.com/pricing
context.originalText:
We’re renaming our Max plans: 

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max is still $100/month, and Ultra is still $200. If you’re a subscriber, there’s nothing you need to do.

We’re also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers. Newer accounts keep a temporary limit until they’re verified, which helps us prevent fraud and abuse. You'll get an email when it's removed.

Weekly limits remain unchanged. View our plans here:  http://claude.com/pricing

context.text:
第 25 天/

我们将把所有 Pro 100/200/500 层级和 Business Premium 的使用限额翻倍，即日生效。

我们听到了你们的友好反馈，不会降低 Pro 200 的使用限额，所以你的 Work 和 Codex 用量将保持不变。我们目前也会继续为 dots 提供扩展限额，你的 dot 的使用仍将与你的默认用量分开。

当然，我们也会继续推出更好的模型和其他效率改进，随着时间的推移提高你的有效用量。
context.originalText:
Day 25/

We are doubling all usage limits for all Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium, effective today.

We heard your kind feedback and won’t be reducing usage limits for Pro 200, so your Work and Codex usage will stay the same. We’re also going to continue offering extended limits for dots for now, and usage of your dot will still continue to be separate from your default usage.

And we'll of course also keep shipping better models and other efficiency improvements that increase your effective usage over time.

context.author: theo
context.text:
T3 Connect 今天一直不太稳定。非常抱歉。现在应该已经恢复了 🤞

下面给关心的人一些技术细节：

T3 Connect 是我们为 T3 Code 的远程连接内置的 Tailscale 替代方案。

结果 T3 Connect 的用户太多了，我们在 Cloudflare 那边撞上了一些速率限制！他们已经确认了自身的问题，正在修复。

我们之前并不知道这些限制（看起来他们也不知道）。我们远低于我们所知的限制，特别是我们可以部署给用户的隧道数量。这些失败的告警也相当粗糙。CF 已经确认了这一切，并正在他们那边进行修复 🙏

有个产品火到把 CloudFlare 搞挂了，真是疯狂 lol。我们正在努力防止今后再出现这类回归问题。

这项工作充满了有趣的挑战。一旦惊群效应开始，我们就有点束手无策了，因为我们无法控制你们那边运行的代码！我们必须提前很久规划变更，因为我们无法保证用户在任何时候都运行最新版本。

感谢大家在此期间与我们共渡难关。如果你想最大化正常运行时间、尽量减少像今天这样连接中断的可能性，我不会失望的——如果你把 Tailscale 设置为备用方案（我个人就是这么做的）
context.originalText:
T3 Connect has not been reliable today. Super sorry about that. Should be recovered now 🤞

Nerdy deets below for those who care:

T3 Connect is our built-in alternative to Tailscale for remote connections on T3 Code.

Turns out there's so many T3 Connect users that we are hitting some rate limits on Cloudflare's side! They have confirmed the issues on their end and are working on fixes.

We were unaware of these limits (seems like they were too). We're well under the limits we knew about, specifically the # of tunnels we can deploy to our users. The alerting on these failures was also pretty rough. CF has confirmed all of this and is working on fixes on their end 🙏

Crazy to have a product so popular that it's taking down CloudFlare lol. We are working hard to prevent these types of regressions going forward.

This work is full of fun challenges. Once a thundering herd starts, we're a bit screwed since we can't control the code you're running on your end! We have to plan way in advance for changes because we can't guarantee that users are on the latest version at any given time.

Thanks for sticking through with us in the interim. If you want to maximize your uptime and minimize chances of connection loss like today, I will not be disappointed if you set up Tailscale as a fallback (I do this personally)

activities.author: thsottiaux
activities.text: 周末有报告称，部分用户的用量消耗速度比预期更快。我们已识别出约 40,000 个账户，这些账户在用量额度上存在不一致，即实际应用的用量与其实际所选套餐不符。我们正在逐一联系所有这些用户，并已修正该问题。如果你受到影响，我们会向你的账户添加额度。抱歉我们搞错了。
activities.originalText: There were reports of usage draining faster than anticipated for some users over the weekend. We've identified approximately 40,000 accounts that had an inconsistency on which usage limits where the actual usage that was applied did not correspond to their actual selected plan. We are reaching out individually to all these users and have corrected the issue. If this affected you, we'll add credits to your account. Sorry we got this wrong.
